description: Inspect a payment session: budget, amount spent, remaining budget, status (active/exhausted/expired/cancelled), expiry time, allowlist, and per-tx ceiling. Optionally include recent payment executions. Requires THREE_WS_SESSION (only the session owner can read it).

include_executions.description: If true, include the 10 most recent payment executions for this session.

session_id.description: UUID of the payment session to inspect.

name: check_payment_session
title: Check a payment session's budget and status
